title: FIRST BOSS OVERHAUL
description: The first boss has been rebuilt with clearer attacks, faster recovery windows, and a founder pack offer that appears after the victory screen.
consequence: Players finally get a first win worth remembering. The store finally gets a customer worth interrupting.

title: STARTER GEAR UNLOCK
description: The early combat pass now gives every new player a full starter kit, replacing the paid convenience bundle that used to sit beside the tutorial.
consequence: Players stop losing their first hour to inventory friction. The tutorial bundle sits beside them, dressed for the wrong party.

title: EXPEDITED CRAFTING TIMERS
description: Early weapon and armor crafting now uses real-time job timers, with premium currency available to speed up workshop completion.
consequence: The first hour learns to wait. The forge discovers urgency is a billable material.

title: MANDATORY CAMP SETUP
description: New players must now place a starter camp, assign storage zones, name three crafting stations, and confirm a base layout before leaving the tutorial island.
consequence: Players meet the sandbox by filling out paperwork. The store has to wait outside.
